name: Arturia KeyLab Essential 61 mk3
source: Arturia KeyLab Essential mk3 User Manual (DAW program; transport mode MCU in MIDI Control Center) and Arturia support 'KeyLab Essential mk3 - DAW Integration'. Its "MCU/HUI" port speaks Mackie Control (driven by Nota's MCU support; its faders have no motors, so they pick up): transport notes 91-95 and 86, faders as pitch bend on channels 1-9, encoders CC 16-23 sign-bit relative, bank / channel notes 46-49. Port names read off the device (macOS: "KL Essential 61 mk3 MCU/HUI"); only its "MIDI" port answers the identity request (00 20 6B / 02 00 / 05 74), so the profile matches by port name.
